note: T11 engine params. Layout v1, Happiness weights, live flags. Derived park capacity and energy buffer are not stored here: build_tick computes them from agents slots and time.offline_cap_ticks_base.

layout_version.why: First DecisionRecord layout. Zero fields ship from day one so a later add is a migration, not a silent tail

happiness_penalty_live.why: Penalty on output is off in v1. Turning it on multiplies exit and would recount T2 bands; precedent season_prizes_live

happiness_penalty_threshold_bps.why: HUD red line at half. Lives in the pack so the interface does not author a second 50 percent

stability_hint_threshold_bps.why: HUD energy hint at 70 percent. Pack-owned so HUD.md cites the param, not a literal

happiness_weight_housing_bps.why: Four Happiness terms have no canon priority. Equal BPS/4 until T3 measures otherwise. Sum of four must be 10000

happiness_weight_parks_bps.why: Equal share with housing energy payroll. Unequal weights need a measurement v1 does not have

happiness_weight_energy_bps.why: Equal share. Energy surplus saturates at the offline-capable warehouse window, not a second authored 12

happiness_weight_payroll_bps.why: Equal share. Unpaid shifts enter as payroll_ratio_bps, already a pack magnitude

jitter_legacy.why: Empty stream omits the colon-suffix so sha256(city:tick:agent) matches every already recorded shift byte for byte

derived.park_capacity_jobs: slots_at_city_level[city_level_at_slots_cap] // (1 + playable_v1_count); parks term saturates at slot cap with every playable district open
derived.energy_buffer_ticks: offline_cap_ticks_base; energy term saturates when stock covers the offline-capable window
derived.record_spec: layout v1 field types for validate_record; not a second copy of DESIGN.md 6.1
derived.header_spec: TickInputHeader field types for validate_header; leaf 0 of the tick tree
derived.remainder_sinks: every floor division on the tick path named with its remainder sink and floor_divs count per function
derived.day_boundary_contours: midnight vs efficiency_recalc_hour; each event in exactly one contour
derived.tick_prng_streams: allowed PRNG stream ids; empty stream is the jitter legacy path
derived.happiness_weights: four term weights from params; sum must equal BPS
derived.tick_codes: codes the tick writes, mapped to HUD surfaces
derived.state_source_producers: screens.state_sources owner T11 to producer function name
derived.lint_l196: L196-L225 titles; rules live in lint.py RULES
